quote:
When one nation tills the field of arms, other minds grow quiet, sensing that the soil of peace is hidden beneath the blades of guns.

The ocean keeps its secrets in drifts of sludge and sirens, yet the bravest scholars learn that the most valuable treasure lies beneath a quiet horizon.

A shadow over a volcano reminds us that the earth’s temper is as old as time, and those who dismiss its warning treat the world not as a garden, but as a firecracker.

The sky offers itself to the wandering eyes bent on birds, yet what most eyes miss, those tempered by patience see as a lesson in moving beyond the glare.

A silent cyber storm rattles the nearest stone in the digital temple, showing that even in halls of stone, electricity can shake the foundation.

A vessel of cloud may carry more than cargo; it can carry an entire council of ghosts that challenge the map drawn by those who fear what lies beyond.

The river of oil that flows from one homeland to another is a bridge built with fire; those who set its lamps may choose the path of peace or the peril of flames.
